home.description: Welcome to Quiz App! Test your knowledge, create your own quizzes, and challenge your friends.

about.title: About Us
about.welcome: Welcome to Quiz App, a modern platform built to make learning engaging and interactive. Our mission is to provide users with an easy-to-use environment where they can challenge themselves, track their knowledge, and have fun while doing it.
about.visionText: We aim to create a community where learning is accessible, interactive, and motivating. By combining technology with thoughtful design, we help users stay curious and continuously improve their skills.

offerList.firstPoint: Wide variety of quizzes across multiple topics
offerList.secondPoint: Progress tracking to monitor your growth
offerList.fourthPoint: Ability to share quizzes and challenge friends

about.contactEnd: We'd love to hear from you.
